title: spac / ipo / sec filing | Unknown | Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing that its Form S-1 registration statement for an IPO of units was declared effective on April 13, 2026, and that the company entered into various IPO-related agreements including an underwriting agreement with D. Boral Capital LLC.
